sources.name: vLLM
sources.evidence: Llama-2-7b TP1 uses K4096, packed gate/up N22016 and down 11008x4096; the Marlin benchmark includes M1 and M16.

sources.name: SGLang
sources.evidence: Packed out-of-place precise SiLU, FP32 activation and multiply, one final FP16 conversion; no fast-math, PDL, expert filtering or input reuse.

shape_policy: A finite complete-chain architecture comparison, not a production trace, model throughput claim or inferred invocation frequency.
numerics: Signed symmetric group128 Q4 with FP16 scales/dequant; FP16 activations/outputs, FP32 reductions, precise SiLU and no TF32.
storage: Shared immutable compressed gate/up and dense down weights; separate queues, buffers and two invocation/output slots per arm; alternate two different resident inputs after true completion.
selection_policy: Keep HYLE as the default only with qualified complete-chain advantage. Otherwise adopt the qualified mature implementation in its legal domain. Other dtype/layout/device/version domains are not ranked by these observations.
